pr_title: SQL: Enforce and document dedicated client version compatibility
pr_body:
Add further dedicated client (xDBC, CLI) compatibility rules and
document these. A client is version-compatible with the server if:
- it supports version compatibility (past or on 7.7.0); and
- it's not on a version newer than server's; and
- it's major version is at most one unit behind server's.

Closes #70400.
pr_comments: Thanks @jrodewig . I think it's much better now that the 7.x-8.x row was split.

issue_context.title: SQL: document and enforce policy around versioning
issue_context.body:
A policy around client compatibility is not currently documented.
While currently the server checks on the client be of a older, but new enough version, further restrictions need to be put in place since unlike ES' other REST API clients, the SQL ones cannot be of a newer version than server's (this leads to errors in cases where types support between server and clients aren't perfectly aligned).

review_comments: Maybe it's better to use a concrete version here, or a relative major below for the client, to be easy to backport to 7.x without changes.

Porting to 7.x shouldn't be an issue, no matter the CURRENT (now being past 7.7.0). The important thing is for the client version to be before 7.7.0 (i.e. lacking the compatibility capability, adding its version to requests etc.).
Please add a comment that we need the 2 args because the server version (current) is not available here (not a dependency).
